```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  rubocop:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '2.7'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop

  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Run TypeScript checks
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

  graphql_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Run GraphQL lint
        run: npx graphql-cli lint

  factory_bot_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '2.7'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run FactoryBot lint
        run: bundle exec rspec spec/factories --format documentation

  rspec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '2.7'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run RSpec tests
        run: bundle exec rspec
      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: coverage

  db_seed:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:latest
        ports:
          - "5432:5432"
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_development
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '2.7'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Create database
        run: rails db:create
      - name: Migrate database
        run: rails db:migrate
      - name: Seed database
        run: rails db:seed
```
